item.title: US death toll in Iran war rises to 7 after service member dies from injuries in Saudi Arabia
item.description: The U.S. death toll in the war in Iran reached seven on Sunday after U.S. Central Command said a service member had been killed from injuries sustained in Saudi Arabia.
